newsitem.title: USA: AOL venture Digital City buys NY Web firm.
newsitem.headline: AOL venture Digital City buys NY Web firm.

text.p: Digital City Inc, a jointly owned venture of America Online Inc and the Tribune Co, said it acquired the key assets of WP Studio as part of its move to begin developing Digital City New York.

Terms were not disclosed. WP Studio, which was founded in 1994 as a division of Web Partners Llc, develops a few Web sites including Total New York, a site for entertainment, new media and cultural information about New York City.
The Digital City venture provides news, sports, weather, traffic, tourist data, entertainment and other localized information on 13 U.S. cities to AOL's 8 million members.

The other Web sites developed by WP Studio include ada'web which was launched to produce original art projects on the Web featuring work of artists such as Jenny Holzer, and Spanker, a satirical look at personal Web pages on the Internet.

The companies said that these Web sites will become productions of Digital Cities Studio and they will produce original programming content for all of Digital City's city sites, to enhance current content areas and develop new features. Digital City will also begin developing Digital City New York which will be launched later this year.
Additional cities are planned for 1997 and beyond.
